Rhea: Heads up — small cohort of new users reported repeated 429s during the onboarding demo.
Rhea: The demo does speculative prefetch of 7 pages when the session starts.
Rhea: One example response: 429 Too Many Requests, Retry-After: 2, X-RI-Quota: 0/60, X-RI-Reset: 47
Kofi (sdk): Which SDKs? We pushed a change last month that serializes token refresh differently. Could be a concurrency gap.
Rhea: Backend uses python-sdk v1.6.5, frontend uses js-sdk v1.4.3.
Kofi (sdk): JS coalesces refreshes; python still allows parallel refresh attempts in async flows. That will create overlapping retries that hammer a low quota.
Morgan (platform): Logs show a spike where 6 refresh calls happened inside a 1s window, then all retried and blew remaining quota down to 0.
Kofi (sdk): Plan: patch python SDK with a refresh mutex keyed by credential + reduce default prefetch for new installs on trial to 2. Also honor Retry-After header exactly.
Kofi (sdk): Quick pseudocode:
```
lock = lock_for(cred_id)
await lock.acquire()
try:
  if token_expired():
    await refresh()
finally:
  lock.release()
```
Rhea: Can SDK also read X-RI-Quota and flip into conservative mode when remaining <= 2? That would prevent background prefetch from running.
Morgan (platform): Yes — we can add that header to docs. Also can provision a small edge smoothing bucket for UI-originated bursts for trials until the SDK patch rolls out.
alerts-bot: deploy-staging: demo-app @ 2026-03-01T11:20:10Z succeeded
Rhea: I flipped DEMO_PREFETCH=1 in the starter environment and pushed to staging. Staging looks fine so far.
Kofi (sdk): I'll open a PR within 4h with the auth-dedupe + default change + a warning log when X-RI-Quota is low. Will add unit test for concurrent refresh.
Morgan (platform): Add idempotency tokens to prefetch endpoints to avoid double-counting on retries where possible.
Rhea: Dev docs note to add: "Trial plans: set DEMO_PREFETCH<=2 and upgrade SDK to v1.6.6+ for auth coalescing."
Kofi (sdk): Also will ensure SDK respects Retry-After instead of immediate exponential retry when header present.
Morgan (platform): I'll draft a short post-incident note and hold off increasing server-side limits. Prefer client and edge mitigations.
Rhea: Thanks — ping this thread if anything else pops up after rollout.
